sentences.text: 亚投行总部位于中国北京，目前有111个成员。
sentences.evidence: Headquartered in Beijing, China, the bank currently has 111 members

sentences.text: 该行在协定于2015年12月25日生效后开始运营。
sentences.evidence: The bank started operation after the agreement entered into force on 25 December 2015

sentences.text: 该行初始资本为1000亿美元。
sentences.evidence: The starting capital of the bank was US$100 billion

sentences.text: 该行由中国于2013年首次提出，2014年10月在北京举行仪式启动。
sentences.evidence: The bank was first proposed by China in 2013 and the initiative was launched at a ceremony in Beijing in October 2014.
